name: payments_platform
note: Long goal: keep a payments service releasable over months. The provider returns a four-milestone DAG that fans out from one foundation milestone and converges on release readiness — the shape a real mission has.

mission.goal: Keep the payments service releasable on any weekday without a heroic effort. Today a release takes two engineers most of a day: the contract tests are flaky, nobody trusts the staging environment, the release checklist lives in someone's head, and every rollback so far has been manual. Over the next few months this should become boring: a green pipeline, a documented and rehearsed rollback, and a staging environment whose result actually predicts production. Do not change the payment provider integration itself — that contract is fixed by the vendor and is out of scope.

milestones.goal: the payments contract tests are deterministic and trusted
milestones.rationale: Nothing downstream can be trusted while the contract suite is flaky.

jobs_draft.title: Quarantine and diagnose the flaky contract tests
jobs_draft.goal: Identify why the payments contract suite is non-deterministic

jobs_draft.title: Pin the vendor sandbox responses
jobs_draft.goal: Replace live sandbox calls with recorded responses

milestones.rationale: A staging environment nobody believes is a cost with no benefit.

jobs_draft.title: Close the staging/production config drift
jobs_draft.goal: Make staging config differ from production only where it must

milestones.goal: a rollback is a rehearsed, documented, single command
milestones.rationale: Manual rollbacks are the reason releases feel risky.

jobs_draft.title: Write the rollback runbook
jobs_draft.goal: One page: what to run, what to check, who to tell

jobs_draft.title: Rehearse a rollback against staging
jobs_draft.goal: Prove the runbook works before it is needed

milestones.goal: any weekday release is a boring, one-person operation
milestones.rationale: The mission's actual outcome, reachable only after the rest.

jobs_draft.title: Collapse the release checklist into the pipeline
jobs_draft.goal: Every manual checklist step becomes a pipeline gate

risks: The vendor sandbox may not support recorded responses for every endpoint.
Staging drift may be caused by infrastructure the team does not own.
assumptions: The vendor payment integration itself stays untouched, as the goal states.
Existing release tooling is extended rather than replaced.
